summary: On August 12, 2026 the IRS released Notice 2026-49, proposing sample forms and standardized procedures for rollovers between employer retirement plans and IRAs under SECURE 2.0 Section 324 (IRA-to-IRA transfers aren't covered). It's still a draft: the IRS is taking public comments through October 23, 2026, so nothing is final or mandatory yet.
suggestedAction: No action needed now. When you eventually roll your 401(k)/403(b) over to an IRA at retirement, expect a more standardized paperwork process; revisit once the IRS finalizes the procedure.
